import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, } from "@/ui/item" import { Component } from "@angular/core" const music = [ { title: "Midnight City Lights", artist: "Neon Dreams", album: "Electric Nights", duration: "3:45", }, { title: "Coffee Shop Conversations", artist: "The Morning Brew", album: "Urban Stories", duration: "4:05", }, { title: "Digital Rain", artist: "Cyber Symphony", album: "Binary Beats", duration: "3:30", }, ] @Component({ selector: "preview-item-image", standalone: true, imports: [ Item, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ], template: `
@for (song of music; track song.title) {
{{ song.title }} - {{ song.album }}

{{ song.artist }}

{{ song.duration }}

 }
`, }) export class ItemImageComponent { protected readonly music = music } export default ItemImageComponent
